portInfo.description: White volcanic rock at Sarakiniko, the mining story in Adamas and archaeology near Trypiti make a coherent shore day. Kleftiko is a sea excursion with its own weather and return constraints; it is not a quick drive to add after the museum. The island’s original Aphrodite statue is in the Louvre: the Plaka museum’s copy is not advertised as the original.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: For a tender call allow 45 minutes each way for queue, boat and landing; a docked small vessel may need less, but do not spend the difference before clearance. Reserve a vehicle from Adamas for Trypiti/Plaka/Sarakiniko and agree the return at the actual landing. The 30–45-minute road legs below are deliberately padded planning budgets, not straight-line distances or bus schedules.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Milos Mining Museum — Adamas, Milos. The port-town museum explains why the island’s landscape and economy are linked. Allow 75 minutes; official source.
Sarakiniko — Sarakiniko volcanic shore, Milos. Bare white rock is the attraction; swimming is optional and conditions-dependent. Allow 75 minutes; official source.

Catacombs of Melos — Trypiti catacombs archaeological site, Milos. Only designated halls are visitable; the winter calendar shown permits Thursday/Sunday, not an everyday visit. Allow 45 minutes; official source.
Ancient Theatre of Melos — Ancient Melos theatre site, near Trypiti. A separate open-air archaeological stop with uneven ground. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
Archaeological Museum of Melos — Plaka, Milos. Look for island archaeology and the Aphrodite copy; confirm current opening. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: The culture authority’s winter catacomb calendar currently shows Thursday/Sunday access only. Do not turn “winter hours” into seven-day availability; use the theatre/port museum alternative when the site is closed.
